era: 2019 Indiegogo (the 2016 redesign kept through 2019): white header with the pink INDIEGOGO wordmark, Explore, What We Do, For Entrepreneurs, pink Start a Campaign, Log In and Sign Up; Benton Sans with a serif display face; square project cards with pink progress bars; explore with Category, Project Timing, Sort By and Project Type filters; campaign pages with Back It, Follow, Story / FAQ / Updates / Comments / Community tabs and perks. The site now runs on Gamefound: its Late Pledge, Pledge Manager, For you, TTRPG, Gaming Culture and Gamefound tabs and the creator pitch are hidden; campaign results, the Spotlight feed and the pledge controls stay.
